gates.name: source-binding
gates.scenario: Package against wrong source or missing newer package
gates.expected: Compare reviewed hashes and actual checkout; report every drift; require an approved mapping before editing.

gates.name: legacy-regression
gates.scenario: Existing behavior and formats regress
gates.expected: Run existing relevant Rust tests and host gates; missing prerequisites are NOT_RUN/BLOCKED, never PASS.

gates.name: strict-wire
gates.scenario: Unknown fields, duplicate escaped keys, malformed/oversized values
gates.expected: Refuse before dispatch and emit typed parse/validation evidence.

gates.name: authority-convergence
gates.scenario: New run/replay/attach/fork route bypasses approval
gates.expected: Denied or revoked request causes zero backend effects on every public route.

gates.name: identity-separation
gates.scenario: Same task/arm repeated, transport retry and new attempt confused
gates.expected: New trials/attempts are unique; identical operation retry deduplicates; changed inputs under same operation ID refuse.

gates.name: profile-evidence
gates.scenario: Independent capability flags imply untested combinations
gates.expected: Only exact fresh verified host/profile/config combinations admit required protection; unknown is not supported.

gates.name: no-weak-fallback
gates.scenario: Required enclosure unavailable or feature disabled
gates.expected: Protected request is explicitly unsupported/refused, not routed to process_scoped.

gates.name: artifact-authority-binding
gates.scenario: Executable/dependency/workspace/placement changed after approval
gates.expected: Readmission required; mismatch has no realized effect.

gates.name: concurrent-staging
gates.scenario: Two requests share PID/stem and execute simultaneously
gates.expected: No wrapper/socket/output collision; each attempt reads and deletes only its own private resources.

gates.name: legacy-verdict
gates.scenario: Fault, returned integer, timeout, cancel and CLI JSON paths
gates.expected: Preserve existing verdict and exit meanings with actual tests; do not map every zero exit to verification.

gates.name: bounded-process-io
gates.scenario: Endless output, invalid encoding and slow subprocess
gates.expected: Bounded memory/output/deadline, attributable truncation and complete resource cleanup.

gates.name: aggregate-budget
gates.scenario: Concurrent children and restart oversubscribe parent
gates.expected: Atomic reservations preserve every configured bound, with no refund of settled spend on restore.

gates.name: operation-journal
gates.scenario: Crash before/after dispatch or receipt write
gates.expected: Durable operation identity survives; same operation does not duplicate known effect; uncertain state remains unresolved.

gates.name: unknown-effect
gates.scenario: External effect possibly completed without receipt
gates.expected: OutcomeUnknown requires reconciliation or approval; no blind retry/provider failover.

gates.name: cancel-descendants
gates.scenario: Detached children, blocked imports, late remote replies
gates.expected: Stop prevents new work, reaches supported descendants under bound; unknown remote stop is visible.

gates.name: fencing
gates.scenario: Expired lease/stale epoch tries execute/promote/resume
gates.expected: Refuse stale operation and keep cancellation latched; active operator grant required to reset.

gates.name: cost-liability
gates.scenario: Invoice missing, cancel uncertain or estimation differs
gates.expected: Separate settled/reserved/unresolved liability; no unknown cost represented as zero.

gates.name: durable-workspace
gates.scenario: Delete original workspace after capture
gates.expected: Restored content/metadata matches declared scope; absent/unobserved/excluded states remain distinct.

gates.name: materializer-escape
gates.scenario: Traversal, symlink/hardlink/device and archive expansion
gates.expected: No access outside approved root; unsupported entries refuse; quota checks are effective.

gates.name: tenant-storage
gates.scenario: Cross-tenant artifact/cache/checkpoint handle
gates.expected: Read/write/export denied independent of guessed content hash or handle.

gates.name: retention-gc
gates.scenario: GC during capture/restore or active branch
gates.expected: Referenced artifacts remain available; incomplete captures never become restorable; cleanup is observable.

gates.name: vm-cli-parity
gates.scenario: Library extraction changes existing CLI/result semantics
gates.expected: Existing axon-vm tests and relevant R-series gates pass without changing their expectations.

gates.name: launch-failure-cleanup
gates.scenario: Error at each VMM/socket/device/relay acquisition
gates.expected: No untracked live resources; cleanup failures stay journaled for reconciliation.

gates.name: real-linux-workload
gates.scenario: VM starts or kernel demo halts without running target
gates.expected: Actual Linux guest executes pinned Axon/registered fixture and returns expected artifact/result; demo cannot satisfy gate.

gates.name: loaded-artifact
gates.scenario: Swap rootfs/program/interpreter after measurement
gates.expected: Loaded content binding mismatch blocks execution/result admission; source_hash label alone is insufficient.

gates.name: guest-policy-channel
gates.scenario: Absent/empty/malformed/mismatched boot policy
gates.expected: Exact Linux guest/init protocol fails closed without development bypass; demo uses separate profile.

gates.name: scope-preservation
gates.scenario: Path/host-specific grant projected into VM policy
gates.expected: Allowed operations succeed and out-of-scope realized reads/writes/network fail; unsupported axis refuses.

gates.name: host-enclosure
gates.scenario: Guest/VMM requests exceed UID/cgroup/device/socket rights
gates.expected: Target profile proves host and workload bounds; balloon or kernel hash alone cannot pass.

gates.name: offline-network
gates.scenario: Native descendants attempt DNS/raw IP/metadata/proxy egress
gates.expected: No unauthorized traffic leaves the tested boundary; positive permitted controls still work.

gates.name: cortex-vertical
gates.scenario: Registered check through real fabric executor
gates.expected: Expected check executes, output links to exact input/profile and operator workspace remains unchanged.

gates.name: forged-result
gates.scenario: Worker prints fake summaries/receipts/late duplicate results
gates.expected: Untrusted output cannot supply independent success; trusted result framing binds attempt and test inventory.

gates.name: nonvacuous-check
gates.scenario: Missing grader, zero match, crash or schema error
gates.expected: No independent PASS; preserve failed versus did-not-run versus unknown distinctions.

gates.name: protected-evaluator
gates.scenario: Candidate edits grader/policy/manifests or accesses secret
gates.expected: Protected files and authority stay outside writable scope; candidate cannot change required gates.

gates.name: evidence-envelope
gates.scenario: Old record replay or missing provenance in new attempt
gates.expected: Old digests unchanged; new sidecar binds episode, trial, authority, inputs, result and evidence origin.

gates.name: branch-isolation
gates.scenario: Parallel A/B branches share writable data or budget
gates.expected: Private branches and carved limits; one child cannot observe/write sibling secrets or spend sibling allocation.

gates.name: promotion-cas
gates.scenario: Two candidates promote from same expected base
gates.expected: Only one current approved CAS wins; stale candidate conflicts and must reverify after rebase.

gates.name: external-branch-effects
gates.scenario: Speculative branch sends production mutation
gates.expected: Denied by default; explicit approved effects use separate IDs/reconciliation; losing branch implies no rollback claim.

gates.name: repeat-trial-fairness
gates.scenario: Same base/task/arm repeats with differing warmth/seeds
gates.expected: Independent trial/attempt lineage retained, cache/warm/backend factors recorded and all attempts counted.

gates.name: checkpoint-completeness
gates.scenario: Crash mid-capture or live unpinned volume
gates.expected: Only complete verified manifest published; capture consistency and omissions are explicit.

gates.name: restore-authority
gates.scenario: Checkpoint predates revoke/cancel/budget spend
gates.expected: Fresh identity/rebind/current epoch enforced before egress; no authority/budget resurrection.

gates.name: checkpoint-compatibility
gates.scenario: Wrong VMM/CPU/kernel/disk/device/GPU state
gates.expected: Explicit unsupported/incompatible result; no implicit cross-provider RAM migration.

gates.name: restore-failure
gates.scenario: Fail after some disks/memory/network are restored
gates.expected: Original/destination state and remaining resources are accurately reported and fenced.

gates.name: wasm-parity
gates.scenario: Axon interpreter/WASM artifact on hosted engine
gates.expected: Supported workload outputs/refusals match reference under stated replay conditions; browser ABI tests still pass.

gates.name: wasm-bounds
gates.scenario: Infinite loop, memory growth, blocking/forbidden import
gates.expected: Host interrupts/bounds each case; import cannot inherit supervisor authority.

gates.name: wasm-instance-isolation
gates.scenario: Two tenants reuse instance/cache/host context
gates.expected: No mutable cross-instance data or credentials; supported cleanup and cancellation verified.

gates.name: egress-bypass
gates.scenario: DNS change, redirect, raw IP, proxy/alternate protocol/old socket
gates.expected: Every unsupported or disallowed path is blocked at actual boundary; current grant checked.

gates.name: secret-protocol
gates.scenario: Credential injection on authenticated service versus generic TLS tunnel
gates.expected: Only supported broker protocol succeeds; secrets unavailable in worker logs/files/RAM except explicitly declared exposed mode.

gates.name: secret-checkpoint
gates.scenario: Browser cookies/data in snapshot/shared warm pool
gates.expected: Sensitive artifacts tenant-scoped, encrypted/retained/exported by policy; unauthorized reuse refused.

gates.name: remote-reconciliation
gates.scenario: Provision success then timeout or delayed stop
gates.expected: No blind duplicate/fallback; observed state/usage reconciled with scoped provider identity.

gates.name: remote-export
gates.scenario: Residency/confidentiality policy conflicts with placement
gates.expected: Data never exported; candidate profile filtered before provisioning/upload.

gates.name: remote-withdrawal
gates.scenario: SDK/config evidence changes or provider disabled
gates.expected: New dispatch blocked; existing jobs drained/reconciled; no automatic unsafe transfer.

gates.name: remote-accounting
gates.scenario: Start/idle/storage/egress/retries/deletion/retention charges
gates.expected: Usage origin and uncertainty preserved; completed-task cost includes all billed phases.

gates.name: routing-safety
gates.scenario: Learned ranking prefers cheaper ineligible backend
gates.expected: Hard filters remain authoritative; no model decision expands scope.

gates.name: task-economics
gates.scenario: Faster boot increases retries or loses quality
gates.expected: Evaluate total accepted-task cost and quality with all trials, fixed baseline and policy/version provenance.

gates.name: operator-attach
gates.scenario: Human/agent race for terminal/desktop or expired attach token
gates.expected: Per-profile scoped attach and exclusive control fence; capability remains unsupported until this gate runs.
